title: Cool Redstone modpack
description: A cool modpack to improve Redstone
body:
This is a cool modpack designed to improve redstone, it contains:
* [Carpet mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/carpet) - To speedup/slowdown time, pushable tile blocks (chests)
* [Fabric api](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) - (required to make the modpack run)
* [Matpack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mattpack) - a minecraft redstone texturepack
* [Mod menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) - to configure mods
* [World edit](https://modrinth.com/plugin/worldedit) - to make building large projects easier

For support see: [discord](https://discord.gg/zJX8uUnQWS)
